dogecoin.text:
Market
Ethereum (#ETH), Dogecoin (#DOGE), and Terra (#LUNA) hits highs in the last seven days. LUNA is highlighted for rising 60% in the season. Bitcoin (#BTC) was also up compared to the past few weeks, but it didn't go over $60K. 

+

Elon Musk buys Twitter and #DOGE bounces

On Monday, Elon Musk's offer to buy Twitter was taken up. The billionaire closed a deal worth $44 billion. Even before the deal was sealed, Twitter stock and #Dogecoin prices skyrocketed.
